core_obligations: Quote part (1) and split the universally exact resolution into short exact sequences of syzygies (proof lines 2828-2835).
Build the lifting inductively: lift P_0 -> N_0, note the composite into N_0 lands in K_0, lift to N_1, and repeat (proof lines 2837-2845).
For homotopy, replace alpha, beta by gamma = alpha - beta and lift gamma_0 through K_0 to h_0 (proof lines 2847-2853).
Show gamma_1 - h_0 d lands in K_1, lift to h_1 and repeat to obtain the homotopy (proof lines 2853-2857).
proof_roadmap: Part (1) and the syzygy decomposition (proof lines 2828-2835).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that every module has a pure projective resolution, that a map of modules lifts to a map of complexes from a pure projective resolution to a universally exact resolution, and that two such lifts inducing the same map are homotopic (statement lines 2808-2826). Part (1) is quoted from the chapter's earlier result; for (2) and (3) the proof first splits the universally exact resolution into universally exact short exact sequences of syzygies, then runs a displayed induction: pure projectivity of P_0 lifts the map to N_0, the composite P_1 -> N_0 lands in K_0 and lifts to N_1, and the pattern repeats; homotopy is obtained by the same induction applied to gamma = alpha - beta, where the image of gamma_0 lies in K_0 and admits a lifting h_0, after which gamma_1 - h_0 d is shown to land in K_1 and the process repeats (proof lines 2828-2857). The level is H3: two inductive constructions, both exhibited step by step rather than summarised.
